cover_letter:
Dear Foxelli Hiring Team,

I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to join Foxelli as an Email Marketing Specialist (Klaviyo), having followed your commitment to building innovative e-commerce brands with a focus on meaningful work and continuous learning. My professional journey as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto and through my personal project mirook.com has cultivated a robust skill set in digital visibility, content strategy, and the practical application of AI tools, which I believe makes me a strong candidate for this role.

At Episto, I am responsible for the full cycle of on-page SEO, from keyword research to content publishing, consistently improving organic visibility and search rankings for client websites. This involves a keen analytical mindset, using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics to track performance and inform strategic decisions—a critical skill for optimizing email campaign metrics. My experience in crafting keyword-targeted blog content also speaks to my ability to develop persuasive, brand-aligned copy that drives engagement.

What particularly excites me about this role is Foxelli’s forward-thinking approach to integrating AI into marketing. My experience goes beyond traditional SEO; I have actively applied structured data, entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO) for mirook.com. I am proficient with AI-assisted content tools, which I am eager to leverage for copy generation and audience targeting in your email campaigns. While I am keen to learn Klaviyo, my foundation in web design (WordPress, Elementor) and responsive design principles provides a strong basis for designing and building effective email templates and layouts.

I am a detail-oriented, reliable professional, adept at picking up new tools and platforms quickly, and passionate about professional growth. I am confident that my analytical capabilities, experience with AI in marketing, content creation skills, and strong desire to contribute meaningfully will allow me to rapidly excel in this role and support Foxelli's continued growth.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I am excited by the prospect of contributing to your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
